item.title: Re-engineering the KAS Platform — Phase 1
item.description: Notes from four months re-architecting SAAMBAT/KAS at TSC: replacing the gateway, dropping internal E2EE, consolidating IAM, standardizing observability, and putting Kafka in the middle.
